errors.text_span: 刻度类型为线性，间隔为5%
errors.evidence: The x-axis tick marks are at 1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 50%, 80%, and 100%. This is not a linear scale, and the intervals are not uniform, let alone a fixed 5%.
This is the range of the data values on the line, not the numerical range of the y-axis itself, which is from 80 to 94.
The y-axis interval is 2, but the unit is not percentage (%). The axis is labeled 'F1-score', without a percentage sign.

The description omits several key data points that define the trend of the line, specifically the steep increase between 1% and 20%. It fails to mention the data points at 5% (86.39), 10% (90.88), and 20% (91.96), jumping from the 1% point to the 50% point.
The description fails to mention the circular markers present on the line at each data point.
